picks.title: Sister Alynda Kusch: "Back" Home Safely
picks.summary: In this devotional, Sister Alynda Kusch compares the voice of the Holy Ghost to a coach calling “Back!” to help a runner return safely to the base. Through personal experiences involving missionary service, prayer, education, and moments of physical difficulty, Sister Kusch shares four ways the Holy Ghost can bless our lives: teaching us what to do, teaching us to pray, helping us remember what we have learned and who we are, and comforting us in difficult moments. picks.title: 223- What Stories are Actually True? I Porter Rockwell I Church History Matters
picks.summary: Porter was more than a legendary frontiersman and lawman. He was a close friend of Joseph Smith, a protector of the Prophet, and a man whose life was deeply shaped by the events surrounding Joseph’s death. In June 1844, Porter helped Joseph and Hyrum cross the Mississippi River as they sought to avoid arrest. When Joseph decided to return to Nauvoo and face the authorities, Porter accompanied him part of the way toward Carthage. Joseph ultimately asked him to return to Nauvoo, concerned for his safety. It was the last time Porter saw Joseph alive.Porter's battle cry was, "Wheat! Wheat! Wheat!"
picks.reason: Church history story about Porter Rockwell's role with Joseph Smith.
